data.description: A UI design system showcase displaying a 'Light Mode (Default Theme)' and a 'Dark Mode' layout. Each section features a color palette grid, a preview of various UI components like buttons and pills, a sample card design, and additional component examples such as typography and status indicators.

objects.name: Color Palette Grid
objects.attributes: 12 color swatches per mode with labels

objects.name: UI Components Preview
objects.attributes: buttons (Primary, Secondary, Accent, Destructive), outline buttons, ghost buttons, disabled buttons, status pills

objects.name: Card Example
objects.attributes: contains brand mark 'H', title, description, and 'Get Started' button

objects.name: Background / Texture Preview
objects.attributes: shows 'Site Noise Background' with dotted pattern

objects.name: Other Component Examples
objects.attributes: typography headings, links, status dots, section kickers, brand marks, pill variants
